Hi Grace,

Quick note — our PilotHarvest pilot goes live next Tuesday and our traffic forecast just doubled after a new partner announcement. We need an emergency headroom boost: 3x concurrency for 48 hours starting 2026-08-25 00:00 UTC. We can cover the run via a one-off prepaid credit; can you confirm:

- whether Redwood can provide a 48‑hour headroom uplift and lock in the token rate for that window
- whether the prepaid credit can be applied as an invoice and then reconciled against actual usage (i.e. true‑up/credit back for unused portion)

PO: PH-PO-4523 (finance will issue on approval)
Finance contact: PilotHarvest Finance <finance@pilotharvest.ai>

We need contract amendment language and an invoice to get this through our procurement team quickly.

Thanks,

Elena Morales
Head of Product
PilotHarvest AI

Date: 2026-08-17T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: request for short-term headroom + settlement

Elena — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the partner announcement.

We can do this two ways:

Option A — Prepaid uplift (recommended):
- You prepay a $30,000 credit (invoice up front). We open a reserved headroom pool that covers 3x concurrency for 48hrs.
- Any unused portion is credited back to your account at month end (true‑up).
- Overrun rate during the window is discounted 10% off standard overrun.

Option B — On-demand uplift:
- We lift capacity for the 48hr window and bill at a 20% uplift to standard overrun rates; no upfront PO required but no refund for unused capacity.

If you want the smoothest procurement path, PO + prepaid credit (Option A) usually clears faster. I attached a short amendment draft to accelerate legal review.

Can you confirm approach and whether PO PH-PO-4523 will be submitted this afternoon? If yes, Ben will push the invoice and Laura will issue the redline for signature.

Warmly,

Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
